title: EvoDS: Self-Evolving Autonomous Data Science Agent with Skill Learning and Context Management
problem: Static action sets and growing execution context prevent data science agents from accumulating reusable capabilities.
assumption_broken: Tools and context compression need not remain fixed hand-designed components.
operational_signature: Decompose → synthesize → execute and validate → cache and promote
load_bearing_mechanism: Validated executable skills are cached and promoted into specialized action spaces when repeated synthesis demonstrates recurring demand.

improver_modified.how: Joint reinforcement learning trains the agents that synthesize skills and control adaptive context compression.

limitations_evident: Only ten MLE-Dojo evaluation instances
Scientific discovery remains limited by backbone knowledge
Condensed ablation details are incomplete

title: Agent libOS: A Runtime Substrate for Capability-Controlled Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Evolving tools and persistent agent state can inadvertently expand authority and enable data exfiltration.
assumption_broken: Making a tool visible does not authorize its operations or information flows.
operational_signature: Propose → check authority and flow → dispatch → record and reconcile
load_bearing_mechanism: Primitive-boundary capability and information-flow checks remain independent of mutable model-visible affordances.
limitations_evident: Not a kernel-grade sandbox
Prompt injection remains possible
Real-model results bind to one provider configuration

title: The Meta-Agent Challenge: Are Current Agents Capable of Autonomous Agent Development?
problem: Task-execution benchmarks do not measure autonomous development of agent systems.
assumption_broken: The agent scaffold can be an optimized output rather than a fixed human-designed evaluation component.
operational_signature: Implement → evaluate → diagnose → revise and test
load_bearing_mechanism: A sandboxed coding agent iteratively programs an agent artifact using development feedback before isolated held-out evaluation.
limitations_evident: Long development cycles are expensive
Inherits narrow benchmark distributions
Pretraining contamination remains possible

title: SePO: Self-Evolving Prompt Agent for System Prompt Optimization
problem: Prompt optimization is limited by a hand-engineered prompt agent that cannot improve with experience.
assumption_broken: The optimizer's own system prompt can be optimized by the same procedure used for task prompts.
operational_signature: Sample parent → rewrite → score improvement → archive and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-referential evolutionary pre-training improves the prompt optimizer before reusing it for target-task optimization.

improver_modified.how: The prompt agent evolves its own system prompt on a multi-task prompt-improvement task.

limitations_evident: Task mixture uses a greedy heuristic
Pre-training adds optimization cost
Non-prompt scaffold evolution is only proposed

title: Parthenon Law: A Self-Evolving Legal-Agent Framework
problem: Legal agents omit material facts, calculations, and deliverables despite stronger base models.
assumption_broken: Reliability can be improved through editable procedural harness artifacts rather than model upgrades alone.
operational_signature: Solve → score and redact → edit reusable controls → gate and promote
load_bearing_mechanism: Rubric-isolated failure feedback drives task-agnostic harness diffs accepted only after safety checks and strict performance improvement.
limitations_evident: Strict matter completion remains low
Requires supervising legal judgment
Held-out learning evaluation separation is unclear

title: Autonomous heterogeneous catalyst discovery with a self-evolving multi-agent digital twin
problem: Inconsistent simulation stages and fragile transition-state endpoints obstruct autonomous catalyst prediction.
assumption_broken: Scientific reliability need not depend primarily on a stronger reasoning model or manual endpoint construction.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → propose geometry → validate and simulate → retain and adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent case, knowledge, and skill bank guides endpoint redesign using deterministic energy and convergence feedback.

improver_modified.how: A parametric retriever is trained from accumulated cases and a supervisory bandit adapts workflow strategy selection.

limitations_evident: Electrochemical interfaces require separately trained potentials
New catalyst discovery remains computationally validated
Fixed holdout is repeatedly used for validation

title: VASO: Formally Verifiable Self-Evolving Skills for Physical AI Agents
problem: Sampled execution success does not establish temporal safety of reusable robot skills.
assumption_broken: Formal counterexamples can optimize reusable skill contracts rather than merely reject individual plans.
operational_signature: Generate contract → induce and verify plan → explain counterexample → refine contract
load_bearing_mechanism: Model-checker counterexamples become textual gradients updating a coupled symbolic and planner-facing skill contract.
limitations_evident: AI-generated proposition mappings are unverified
Only sequential skill execution is modeled
Task completion is evaluated in simulation

title: EpiEvolve: Self-Evolving Agents for Streaming Pandemic Forecasting under Regime Shifts
problem: Static epidemic forecasters recover slowly when deployment regimes change and labels arrive late.
assumption_broken: Deployment adaptation can occur through outcome-derived memory rather than parameter updates.
operational_signature: Forecast → observe delayed outcomes → reflect and distill → retrieve regime-relevant lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical episodic reflections and confidence-gated strategic rules condition a frozen forecaster under regime-aware retrieval.
limitations_evident: One processed COVID hospitalization stream
Trend classification is not full epidemiological forecasting
Sensitive to retrieval and reflection design

title: SkillComposer: Learning to Evolve Agent Skills for Specification and Generalization
problem: One-shot skill extraction cannot balance task-specific guidance with reusable generalization.
assumption_broken: Creating, specializing, and merging skills can be learned as distinct transferable operations.
operational_signature: Extract → merge similar strategies → execute → refine from experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Delta-pass-rate rejection sampling trains create, improve, and merge operators for complementary specialization and abstraction.

improver_modified.how: Supervised fine-tuning on rejection-sampled skill-operation examples trains the composer itself.

limitations_evident: Training-data rejection sampling is expensive
Only two Qwen model scales evaluated
Irrelevant skills can hurt simpler tasks

title: From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
problem: Outcome-driven harness optimization cannot reliably locate implementation mechanisms causing agent failures.
assumption_broken: Failed trajectories can be compiled into implementation-aligned diagnostic evidence rather than summarized as final scores.
operational_signature: Align traces → attribute recurring flaws → patch scoped mechanisms → validate regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: A trace intermediate representation links failure steps to editable artifacts and constrains repairs through flaw-specific specifications.
limitations_evident: Requires trace access and implementation artifacts
Diagnosis remains imperfect
Benchmarks use sampled subsets

title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
problem: Isolated search branches and memoryless coding waste long-horizon algorithm discovery budgets.
assumption_broken: Candidate search can reuse cross-branch evidence and progressively change exploration strategy.
operational_signature: Select → retrieve and combine experience → implement and execute → update graph and memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive graph search adds cross-branch reference edges and shifts toward elite exploitation as experience accumulates.
limitations_evident: Main baselines use different published runtime budgets
Single H200 and substantial memory required
Held-out search versus final evaluation is not detailed

title: Elmes*: Automated Construction of Fine-Grained Evaluation Rubrics for Large Language Models in Long-Tail Educational Scenarios
problem: Expert-authored pedagogical rubrics do not scale to diverse educational scenarios.
assumption_broken: Evaluation criteria and test-data synthesis prompts can co-evolve rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Generate → score and diagnose → revise criteria and synthesis → monitor drift and roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: SceneGen co-refines rubric descriptions and data prompts while anchoring frozen examples and preserving rubric identities and weights.
limitations_evident: Offline simulated learners only
Text-only interactions
LLM judges exhibit self-preference

title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
problem: Open-world agents may lack both reusable skills and target-task feedback for improvement.
assumption_broken: External resources can provide verification anchors as well as knowledge without revealing hidden target answers.
operational_signature: Acquire grounded knowledge → build proxy tests → refine skills → deploy frozen artifacts
load_bearing_mechanism: An isolated verifier constructs deterministic practice tests from independently verifiable anchors to guide skill revision.
limitations_evident: External sources can be noisy or stale
Proxy verifier agreement is only 60.7%
Open-world retrieval adds latency and cost

title: FinEvolveBench: A Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents on Low-Repetition Tasks with Implicit Rewards
problem: Experience mechanisms are poorly understood when feedback is noisy, delayed, nonstationary, and weakly reusable.
assumption_broken: External experience does not reliably improve agents across all deployment scenarios.
operational_signature: Predict → wait for matured outcomes → update experience → retrieve for subsequent decisions
load_bearing_mechanism: A fixed chronological news and market replay exposes experience mechanisms to jointly challenging feedback and reuse conditions.
limitations_evident: Chinese A-share news and industries only
Predictive correlations are not trading returns
Metadata annotation can introduce errors

title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
problem: Automatically assembled data pipelines can execute incorrectly or miss seed-specified training-data quality.
assumption_broken: Both the operator library and its orchestration can evolve from small high-quality example specifications.
operational_signature: Infer profile → repair operator graph → trial and judge → accumulate discrepancies and rebuild
load_bearing_mechanism: Trial-output discrepancies update experience that jointly refines data understanding, operator capabilities, and pipeline structure.
limitations_evident: Text data only
Depends on seed quality and LLM feedback
Matched recent agentic-system comparisons deferred

title: Socratic-SWE: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Trace-Derived Agent Skills
problem: Static synthetic repair tasks do not track coding agents' evolving capability gaps.
assumption_broken: Solving traces can guide future curriculum construction rather than being discarded after reward computation.
operational_signature: Distill traces → generate targeted tasks → validate and align gradients → train and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Trace-derived skills steer repository task generation, with gradient alignment rewarding curricula useful to the current solver.

improver_modified.how: Shared generator and solver weights are jointly optimized using generator GRPO and solver GDPO objectives.

limitations_evident: Fixed repository pool eventually saturates
Depends on representative trusted validation gradients
Requires executable sandboxed verification

title: Skill-3D: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic 3D Spatial Reasoning
problem: Uniform tool-use policies fail to acquire scene-specific geometric evidence.
assumption_broken: Tool workflows should depend on scene-task evidence needs rather than fixed preferred tools.
operational_signature: Record outcomes → distill workflows and lessons → retrieve by scene → execute and refine
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful scene-conditioned workflows and failed-rollout lessons jointly evolve a compact skill library that guides evidence acquisition.
limitations_evident: Indoor spatial reasoning only
All evaluation benchmarks contribute training examples
External perception tool quality constrains evidence

title: PACE: Anytime-Valid Acceptance Tests for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Greedy acceptance on noisy reused development data accumulates false and harmful self-modifications.
assumption_broken: A positive development-score difference is not sufficient evidence to commit an edit.
operational_signature: Propose → pair evaluations → accumulate statistical evidence → commit or reject
load_bearing_mechanism: A paired betting e-process admits edits only after crossing an anytime-valid per-candidate evidence threshold.
limitations_evident: Guarantee is per candidate, not run-level
Small gains can be rejected for insufficient power
One model family and proposer tested

title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control
problem: Black-box fluid controllers are difficult to inspect and can generalize poorly across changing wakes.
assumption_broken: Autonomous fluid control can be designed as explicit feedback code without a deployed neural policy.
operational_signature: Sample designs and lessons → revise controller → simulate → retain and rank designers
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving controller code and inherited design knowledge turns multimodal CFD evidence into reusable physical feedback structures.

improver_modified.how: Design agents revise inherited control-design knowledge and are selected through simulation-derived Elo scores.

limitations_evident: Entirely CFD simulation based
Generalization changes one environmental factor at a time
Some individual feedback terms have small isolated effects

title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
problem: Raw clinical trajectory memories are noisy and do not distinguish useful from harmful experience.
assumption_broken: Semantic relevance alone is insufficient for retaining and retrieving clinical memory.
operational_signature: Retrieve → distill informative trajectories → assess contextual utility → promote merge or remove
load_bearing_mechanism: Category-conditioned outcome advantages assign skill utility that jointly controls retrieval and repository governance.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses clinical benchmark environments
Outcome-based utility depends on reward quality
Multi-stage distillation and governance add overhead

title: Memory Beyond Recall: A Dual-Process Cognitive Memory System for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Retrieval-only memory loses belief evolution and latent cross-domain personalization patterns.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory requires asynchronous abstraction and revision structure beyond passage retrieval.
operational_signature: Persist and reconcile → link revisions → induce schemas → abstract cross-domain patterns
load_bearing_mechanism: A dual-process memory combines supersedes chains with behavioral-similarity collisions that induce higher-level schemas.
limitations_evident: English chat-assistant scenarios only
Cross-domain sweep scales quadratically
Inferred user patterns raise consent concerns

title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
problem: Manual model-specific harness engineering cannot keep pace with diverse evolving LLMs.
assumption_broken: The target model can propose its own harness improvements without a stronger external optimizer.
operational_signature: Mine weaknesses → propose minimal edits → test both splits → merge non-regressive changes
load_bearing_mechanism: Verifier-grounded failure clusters drive bounded harness edits promoted only when one split improves and neither regresses.

improver_modified.how: The same model uses the current editable harness in its proposer role, so accepted harness revisions can alter subsequent proposal execution.

limitations_evident: Reported held-out split is used for promotion
Fixed bounded benchmarks rather than open-ended evolution
Non-regression is insufficient for high-stakes safety

title: Auto-Configuring Scientific Simulators with Lightweight Coding-Agent Adapters
problem: Simulator-specific executable contracts make reliable scientific input-deck configuration slow and error-prone.
assumption_broken: Scientific simulator adaptation need not rebuild the coding agent loop or modify its model.
operational_signature: Inspect trajectories → rewrite interface guidance → validate candidates → retain improvements
load_bearing_mechanism: A compact evolvable adapter supplies simulator vocabulary and validation-gated completion while preserving the frozen coding harness.
limitations_evident: Gains concentrate on catastrophic-output rescue
Schema checks do not ensure physical correctness
Small held-out GEOS evaluation

title: TabClaw: An Interactive and Self-Evolving Agent for Spreadsheet Manipulation and Table Reasoning
problem: Table agents repeatedly rediscover workflows and fail to preserve user preferences and corrective feedback.
assumption_broken: Completed analyses can become reusable personalized skills rather than disposable interaction traces.
operational_signature: Record workflows → discover recurring patterns → distill skills → revise from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent workflow records support user-approved skill installation and feedback-driven revision across sessions.
limitations_evident: Long-term skill evolution utility not evaluated
Preliminary task-accuracy evaluation
Human correction effort and trust unmeasured

title: Trace2Policy: From Expert Behavior Traces to Self-Evolving Decision Agents
problem: One-shot expert-policy extraction misses implicit enterprise conventions and leaves systematic decision errors.
assumption_broken: Auditable external rule quality can matter more than executor model capability on calibrated decision workloads.
operational_signature: Execute rules → cluster errors → patch root causes → gate regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Root-cause-specific patches deepen an interpretable rule document using labeled cases and regression feedback.
limitations_evident: Compilation benefits confounded with engineering
Auditor labels may be anchored by recommendations
Small held-out and cross-domain probes

title: EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents
problem: A single evolving prompt suffers destructive interference across heterogeneous task streams.
assumption_broken: Task routing and specialized prompts should be jointly optimized rather than fixing a shared adaptation path.
operational_signature: Initialize specialists → evolve routing → refine routed prompts → stabilize partitions
load_bearing_mechanism: Interleaved router and prompt evolution preserves complementary task behaviors in router-conditioned prompt slots.
limitations_evident: Requires prepared labeled adaptation data
Unrelated knowledge QA can regress
Reported token costs cover final inference rather than search

title: ProPlay: Procedural World Models for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Memory and planning remain disconnected in partially observable environments with sparse feedback.
assumption_broken: Reusable environment knowledge should represent procedural transitions rather than isolated actions or rules.
operational_signature: Rehearse procedures → execute flexibly → induce transitions → update reliability
load_bearing_mechanism: A continually refined procedure graph supplies task-conditioned soft preplay guidance using reward-weighted transition reliability.
limitations_evident: Procedures overgeneralize precise quantitative constraints
Static single preplay plan cannot revise mid-episode
Open-ended environment transfer untested

title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
problem: Entangled static harnesses waste execution traces and make adaptive runtime engineering brittle.
assumption_broken: The runtime harness can be a typed composable optimization object rather than fixed scaffolding around model training.
operational_signature: Digest traces → plan edits → evolve components → critique and gate
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed processor substitutions make trace-driven harness edits auditable and enable isolated variants that reduce cross-task forgetting.
limitations_evident: All gains measured on evolution tasks
Binary pass@2 hides accumulating regressions
Trace observability does not prevent reward hacking

title: Toward Vibe Medicine: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical Decision Support
problem: Static clinical agents fail to incorporate longitudinal outcomes and previous treatment failures across sessions.
assumption_broken: Clinical support can adapt through persistent experience, model updates, and code changes rather than fixed pretrained behavior.
operational_signature: Collect clinical feedback → distill knowledge → update capabilities → reassess decisions
load_bearing_mechanism: A clinical evolution manager is intended to convert accumulated feedback into memory, model, and code updates within an isolated architecture.
limitations_evident: Evolution components not individually evaluated
Safety mechanisms lack dedicated validation
Small-model benchmarks do not establish clinical reliability

title: VisualClaw: A Real-Time, Personalized Agent for the Physical World
problem: Streaming multimodal agents face expensive visual context and static skill scaffolds that cannot learn from failures.
assumption_broken: Successful memories can improve the low-frequency skill evolver instead of enlarging every inference prompt.
operational_signature: Filter observations → retrieve skills → diagnose failures → evolve and prune skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieved successful memories condition failure-driven skill-bank updates while deduplication and utility pruning control bank growth.
limitations_evident: Offline evolver depends on scored failures
Cascaded frame rejection can discard useful evidence
Real-world clinical or wearable deployment not established
